additional_info.subject: Request for Ticket Creation - Issue with Left Connector DC1 - D Y2/S2 313518164001
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I am writing to report an issue with the left connector DC1 of the
Sicharge charging station
(Model:
D Y2/S2 313518164001
) located at the client
Sitrans
, and to request the creation of a service ticket.
Here are the details of the incident:
•1
st Test:
• At 3:00 PM, a Volvo Trucks vehicle attempted several times to connect to the DC1 connector without success.
• The driver was then able to connect easily to the DC2 connector.
• 2
nd Test:
• At 4:23 PM, Mr. Grisval tested the DC1 connector again with a Renault Trucks tractor.
• The issue persists, making the DC1 connector unusable.
This malfunction is causing significant complications for the client, as they are unable to charge their trucks as planned, which directly impacts their transport schedule.
I kindly request the creation of a ticket to address this issue and ensure it is resolved promptly.
Additionally,
@COLLET, SEBASTIEN
, could you please look into this case in advance, if possible? Your support in minimizing the impact on the client would be greatly appreciated.
Thank you for your prompt attention and assistance.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:
+33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
Design and installation of EV charging equipment and infrastructure
.

François,
J’ai réalisé un test avec le client ;
Ils sélectionnent bien le connecteur avant de brancher.
Ils vont néanmoins passer l’instruction pour les autres chauffeurs.
Un camion A était en charge sur le DC2 et nous avons mis en charge un autre camion B sur DC1.
Tout a bien fonctionné.
En revanche, en voulant switcher le camion A sur DC2 et le B sur DC1, lors de l’arrêt de charge de A sur DC1 cela a mis la borne en rouge toute la station. Les 2 SECC Flags étaient en erreur.
Voici les logs.
J’ai donc réalisé un soft reboot.
A cette issue, j’ai réalisé une charge sur DC1 qui a démarré très bien.
Puis nous avons tenté de lancer le camion sur DC2 et nous avons rencontré des difficultés, après plusieurs essais la charge a démarré.
Merci d’analyser pourquoi les 2 SECC se sont mise en erreurs et de comprendre pourquoi nous avons eu des tentatives de démarrage de charge infructueuses.
With best regards,
Avec mes meilleures salutations,

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0395040-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/S2 313518164001] Charging issue in DC1 CRM:00643001154
additional_info.body:
Hi Nevo,
Greetings of the day!
We have checked the logs and charger remotely, and both outlets are available and currently in use for charging sessions. The charging session completed in the last 3 hours was stopped remotely, with the EV's SOC around 88-90%. The only time an outlet was unavailable was due to a CoAP polling issue which was related to SECC's, which is already being addressed to the concerned team. It may be necessary to align for site intervention to inspect the DC cable and assess the feasibility, as well as to check if any foreign particles or dust in the pins are hindering the charging sessions.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
